items.title: Paul Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: keeping his jazz chops sharp with Clark Terry, Stan Kenton and Zoot Sims.

ctx.x: Pianist Paul Smith was born in San Diego on April 17, 1922. He received classical training as a youth and after military service began performing with Les Paul, Tommy Dorsey, Louie Bellson and numerous others. Paul has established a reputation as a superlative accompanist and he has recorded with Ella Fitzgerald, Anita O’Day and Steve Allen. He spent many years in television and movie studios while keeping his jazz chops sharp with Clark Terry, Stan Kenton and Zoot Sims. He current lives in the Los Angeles area…
Paul was interviewed in Los Angeles on February 14, 1999, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
